svg.title: About me — from pixel to database
svg.text: Trained in multimedia (BUT MMI), now in a Full-Stack
Bachelor at CODA. I started with the front — Figma
mockups, React, accessibility — then moved down to
the back. I've shipped a product used by L'Oréal, a
client website on my own and a real-time app used live.
Looking for an alternance in front-end or full-stack development
